title: Isabelle Pool Server: a pooled verification service for prover training and multi-agent proving
abstract: arXiv:2611.24788v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Isabelle Pool Server (IPS), a verification service with a pool of warm headless Isabelle sessions behind an HTTP API, with session leasing and reclamation, memory-aware admission control, and a time budget on every call. Its verification interface spans single-step execution, block-level proof checking and whole-theory builds, with checkpoints for cheap branching and backtracking, and a build from scratch as the final arbiter. The service runs as a single container with monitoring and is accessible via a Python client, two MCP servers and a raw HTTP API. In our measurements IPS is level with PIDE MCP, a PIDE frontend for agents, at one worker and ahead of it at eight, at its commit of October 2026 (the tool is now PIDE AI). Once its sessions are up it scales to 32 concurrent workers on one host at 24 times the single-worker rate, and under memory pressure it refuses new sessions rather than losing existing ones. translated_title: Isabelle Pool Server：用于证明器训练与多智能体证明的池化验证服务
translated_abstract: Isabelle Pool Server（IPS）是一种验证服务，它在 HTTP API 后面维护一个由预热的无头 Isabelle 会话组成的池，具备会话租借与回收、内存感知的准入控制，以及每次调用的时间预算。其验证接口涵盖单步执行、块级证明检查和整个理论构建，并带有检查点以支持低成本的分支与回溯，同时以从零开始的完整构建作为最终仲裁者。该服务以单个容器的形式运行并带有监控，可通过 Python 客户端、两个 MCP 服务器和原始 HTTP API 访问。根据我们的测量，在单工作者情况下 IPS 与 PIDE MCP（一个面向智能体的 PIDE 前端）持平，而在八名工作者时优于后者（截至 2026 年 10 月该工具的提交版本，该工具现已更名为 PIDE AI）。一旦其会话启动，IPS 可在一台主机上扩展至 32 个并发工作者，达到单工作者速率的 24 倍；并且在内存压力下，它会拒绝新会话而不是丢失现有会话。IPS 是自由软件……
tldr: 提出 IPS 池化验证服务，通过预热 Isabelle 会话池、内存感知准入控制和检查点机制支持证明器训练与多智能体证明，可在一台主机上扩展至 32 个并发工作者并达到单工作者 24 倍的吞吐率。
en_tdlr: IPS is a pooled verification service with warm headless Isabelle sessions behind an HTTP API, enabling prover training and multi-agent proving while scaling to 32 concurrent workers on one host at 24 times the single-worker rate.
